title: OntoUML Mode
inspected_scope: Intrinsic mode dependence and exactly one bearer; abstractness summary not used as an unconditional rule because official issue list reports a documentation issue.

title: OntoUML MemberOf
inspected_scope: Whole must be a collective; portfolio scope inclusion alone does not establish this.

title: Events as Entities
inspected_scope: Sections 3.1–3.2: past occurrences, time boundaries, participation, historical immutability.

title: RRO
inspected_scope: Loaded program copies as dispositions in a machine; not assumed identical to configured whole.

title: ROoST
inspected_scope: Sections 3.1, 4, detailed Test Script, Test Plan, Test Execution and Test Result; script is code, not every manual procedure; cardinality differences prohibit automatic equivalence.

title: PROV-O
inspected_scope: Sections 3.1 and 3.2: Entity, Activity, provenance and Plan; broad interoperability only.

title: Data Quality Vocabulary
inspected_scope: Sections 4.1–4.2 distinguish Metric and QualityMeasurement; its data-quality scope is narrower than generic product metrics.

title: Canonical Market TTL
inspected_scope: 22 OWL classes; CompetitorRole exists, alternativeTo is a property; Pain and MarketInsight are not declared as classes.

title: Canonical Market glossary
inspected_scope: Contextual competition and alternatives; identity stays with external owner.

title: Product Management core
inspected_scope: 30 named concepts; EvidenceRecord, EvidenceSourceReference, EvidenceAssessment and ManagementInsight exist; generic Metric not listed.

title: Product external map
inspected_scope: Explicit unresolved owner contracts; no Product reownership; PROV range broad only.

title: Federation lock
inspected_scope: Canonical repository and immutable owner refs inspected.

title: Consumer contract
inspected_scope: Use owner release; historical copies not silently promoted into canonical semantics.

title: OntoUML Vocabulary
inspected_scope: Event, participation, begin/end in the vocabulary; serialization is not domain-semantic acceptance.

title: OntoUML documentation issues
inspected_scope: Issue list reports Modes defined as abstract; no forced abstractness change from one documentation cell.
